function: Joint design of sensing transmit waveform (learned singular values) and communication receive beamforming (closed-form recovery) for uplink ISAC, maximizing weighted normalized sensing and communication rates (pp. 6, 8).
system: Dual-function BS with Nt=16 transmit and Nr=16 receive antennas, K=5 single-antenna users, waveform length L=20; no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 9).
method: ISACNN: CNN (3 convolutional layers, batch norm, FC, Lambda layer) trained unsupervised with the negative weighted-rate objective as loss, no labels; Adam optimizer (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh small-scale fading, path loss 128.1+37.6log10(d) from a 3GPP CoMP document, random sensing covariance; 10,000 samples (8,000 train/2,000 validation), 2,000 test (pp. 8, 13).
test_conditions: Training and test samples drawn from the same random generator (8,000/2,000/2,000); sweeps over SNR, K, antennas, weight and CSI accuracy are reported; no train-test mismatch is stated (pp. 8-12).
baselines: Non-learned: AO with SCA (traditional), average power scheme, ZFBF with SIC [14] (p. 8). Learned: fully connected NN [25], compared only by loss curves (p. 8, Fig. 6).
metrics: Weighted sum of normalized sensing and communication rates (WSNR), sensing rate, communication rate, sum communication rate (bits/s/Hz), training/validation loss, runtime in ms (pp. 8-12).
complexity: Orders: O(Nt^3) preprocessing, layer-wise network forward cost, O(K Nr^3 + L^2 Nt^2) recovery; measured runtime 0.14-0.29 ms versus Nt, Nr, K (Table I) (pp. 8-9).
q1_support: p. 8: "The Rayleigh fading is considered" as small-scale fading; path loss "PLdB = 128.1 + 37.6 log10 (d) [30]" comes from a 3GPP CoMP document (p. 13). Custom simulator with only the path loss from 3GPP; no TR 38.901 model, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "we yield 2000 testing" samples from the same generator as training. Sweeps over SNR, K, antennas, weight and CSI accuracy (pp. 9-12) are not stated as tests of a model trained elsewhere, and the input size 2NrK+Nt (p. 6) depends on Nr, K, Nt. No new scenario, band, dataset or site.
q3_support: p. 8: "loss curve for FC-NN both oscillate violently": the learned baseline FC-NN [25] appears only in Fig. 6 (p. 10) as loss-versus-epoch curves; Fig. 7 (p. 10) compares the weighted rate only with non-learned Traditional (AO-SCA), Average and ZFBF schemes.
q4_support: p. 8: "average runtime (ms) of the proposed DL-based scheme in" Tab. I (values on p. 9); p. 8 also gives the orders C1 = O(Nt^3), C3 = O(K Nr^3 + L^2 Nt^2) and the network forward cost C2.
q5_support: p. 8: "we generate 10000 training samples" with the authors' own simulator; no code or data link in the paper, no public channel dataset (DeepMIMO, DeepSense 6G) and no measured data.
notes: PDF is arXiv:2403.01480v1 (3 Mar 2024), 'Deep Learning-based Design of Uplink Integrated Sensing and Communication' (Qi, Chen, Zhong, Yuen, Zhang); the DOI is not printed in the text, so the match rests on title, authors and date. RIS appears only as related work (p. 2). Borderline q3: Fig. 6 (p. 10) plots loss (negative weighted rate) of ISACNN and FC-NN per epoch, FC-NN ends near -0.73 to -0.745 with 1e3-5e3 samples versus about -0.76 for ISACNN, equal at 1e4-2e4, but the text frames it as convergence and oscillation, and Fig. 7 has no learned baseline; reviewer may judge otherwise.
